<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>ElBruno.AgentsOrchestration.Orchestration</id>
    <version>0.5.5</version>
    <authors>Bruno Capuano</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <icon>logo_01.png</icon>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <description>Ultralight multi-agent orchestration engine for the Microsoft Agent Framework. Implements a 6-step pipeline (Plan, Parse, Execute, Verify, Review, Report) with event streaming via System.Threading.Channels.</description>
    <tags>ai agents orchestration microsoft-agent-framework copilot pipeline events</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/elbruno/elbruno.agentsorchestration" commit="af3c4212ba66373aa7be1a3a768cbb72b2cb7d07" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="ElBruno.AgentsOrchestration.Abstractions" version="0.5.5" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
